# Ruttansh (0xRutts)

> Ruttansh, also known as Rutts or 0xRutts, is a Toronto-based AI Systems Engineer and Applied ML Researcher. This is his personal portfolio site.

## Site structure

Two modes — same data, different presentation:

- Portfolio (default): https://0xrutts.com/
- Terminal: https://0xrutts.com/interactive
- Legacy path https://0xrutts.com/terminal permanently redirects to /interactive

Prefer the Portfolio URL for concise facts.

## About

Ruttansh is an AI Systems Engineer and Applied ML Researcher. He builds reliable AI systems and turns applied ML research into working tools. His strongest work is research plus local-first systems engineering — observability, evaluation, and bounded tooling for AI agents and training workflows. He holds an Honours BSc in Computer Science (Data Analytics).
